OBST 501.title: Reproductive Endocrinology I
OBST 501.description: Neuroendocrine regulation of reproduction, regulation of the ovarian and testicular function.

OBST 502.title: Physiology of the Mother, Fetus and Newborn
OBST 502.description: Functional development of the placenta and major organ systems in the fetal and newborn period in man and animals.

OBST 503.title: Fetal and Perinatal Metabolism

prerequisite.raw: Knowledge of fetal growth and development, physiology, pathology of labour

OBST 503.prerequisiteText: Knowledge of fetal growth and development, physiology, pathology of labour

OBST 504.title: Reproductive Endocrinology II
OBST 504.description: Lectures and seminars on cellular processes in hormone secretion, steroid biosynthesis, steroid transport and metabolism, mechanism of hormone action, prostaglandins in reproduction.

OBST 505.title: Experimental Techniques in Reproductive Biology
OBST 505.description: Laboratory course on: cell and organ cultures, radioimmunoassay of steroid and protein hormones and prostaglandins, in vitro fertilization, neuroendocrine techniques, techniques to study fetuses, techniques for metabolic studies in newborn animals.

OBST 507.title: Perinatal Epidemiology
OBST 507.description: Indicators of maternal/newborn well-being across population subgroups, changing trends in obstetrical intervention, perinatal morbidity, and the analysis of perinatal data.
